author: gmarcialcalleja (AI-assisted)
summary: Add explicit two-channel GPIO output adapter and bounded bench command
details: Implement the remaining CS-023 output adapter using lazily imported GPIO Zero, explicit distinct BCM pins and active-high initial-off devices. Latch write faults, request both off independently and release partial initialization/cleanup resources. Add opt-in off-only/single-pulse bench command and accurate scheduler output-mode reporting. Existing policy remains simulation-only. CS-009 is retained as a physical acceptance dependency; no GPIO or motors used.
validation: 15 fake-device adapter/CLI tests and 28 existing scheduler tests passed. Full edge discovery ran 220 tests successfully with 8 platform skips on Windows Python 3.14. Simulation CLI and bench help passed. Shared repository checks are run by publish_task before commit/push. No physical, electrical, or real-time acceptance claimed.
